scholarships.name: High Achiever's Scholarship
scholarships.description: Students who demonstrate exemplary academic ability and achievement will automatically be considered for the High Achiever’s Scholarship. The value of the scholarship is up to 30% of total programme tuition fees, depending on the level of academic performance.

scholarships.name: Holistic Excellence Award
scholarships.description: The Holistic Excellence Award recognises truly exceptional students who demonstrate outstanding all-round achievement, meaningful engagement within their communities, and evidence of personal growth. Students who meet the High Achiever (HAS 30%) academic criteria will be invited to apply.

scholarships.name: Leadership Excellence Award
scholarships.description: The Leadership Excellence Award celebrates student leaders who have made a significant impact through their ability to inspire, influence, and serve as role models within their schools or communities. Eligible candidates include those who have held distinguished positions such as Head Prefect, Club

scholarships.name: Special Talent Award
scholarships.description: The Special Talent Award acknowledges creative and innovative individuals who have demonstrated excellence and gained recognition in fields such as the arts, performing arts, technology, or innovation at state or national level. scholarships.name: Sports Achievement Award
scholarships.description: The Sports Achievement Award recognises outstanding athletes who have excelled in approved sports at state or national level, demonstrating commitment, discipline, and excellence in performance. Applications for this award is by submission, and shortlisted candidates will be subject to an interview

scholarships.description: Endorsed applicants are invited to a virtual interview with the PhD Scholarship Panel. The top five candidates are awarded scholarships based on combined written and interview scores.
